content.text:
**Finding: Compliant (preferred position)** — no redline proposed.

- **No exclusivity binds us.** Clause 12.3 expressly records that Customer may engage any supplier and has made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **No volume lock-in.** Clause 2.1 confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and that declining further Order Forms is not a breach or shortfall.
- **Exclusivity running our way is preserved.** Clause 12.4 restrains Vendor from marketing a service competing with our analytics products — this benefits us and is left untouched per the redline guidance.
- **Other "exclusive" hits are unrelated:** non-exclusive access licence (§13), exclusive jurisdiction (§28.2), and exclusive-remedy references (§§19, 21, 30).
